questions.q: Where is 'Create Journal in Spreadsheet' launched from?
options: File Import and Export under Tools
The Correct Import Errors page
Scheduled Processes
The Journals work area within General Accounting
questions.explain: Create Journal in Spreadsheet is launched directly from the Journals work area in General Accounting, provided the ADFdi add-in is installed.

questions.q: What is the single biggest practical difference between Create Journal in Spreadsheet and the FBDI Journal Import pipeline from Chapter 4?
options: There is no actual difference between them
ADFdi requires more scheduled processes than FBDI
ADFdi collapses the entire template-to-CSV-to-ZIP-to-UCM-to-two-scheduled-processes pipeline into one upload action inside the spreadsheet
ADFdi cannot be used for journals at all
questions.explain: ADFdi skips FBDI's entire staging pipeline — there's no CSV, ZIP, UCM upload, or separate load/import steps; the spreadsheet submits directly.

questions.q: Does the balancing rule (debits must equal credits) still apply when using Create Journal in Spreadsheet?
options: No — ADFdi has no validation rules at all
Yes — it's the same underlying business rule enforced by Journal Import, just applied through a different mechanical path
Only if the user manually checks it themselves
Only for journals over $1 million
questions.explain: The underlying General Ledger business rule doesn't change based on which tool loads the data — debits must still equal credits, whether loaded via FBDI or ADFdi.

questions.q: Why does validation feedback typically arrive faster with ADFdi than with FBDI's Journal Import?
options: Because ADFdi talks to the live application directly, so issues like an invalid account combination can be flagged within the same session, rather than in a later scheduled process report
Because ADFdi skips all validation entirely
Because FBDI is always slower regardless of circumstances
Because ADFdi only works at night
questions.explain: Since ADFdi connects directly to the live application, much of its validation happens close to the moment of upload, rather than being discovered later in an asynchronous report.

questions.q: Why would a controller posting 10 journal lines this afternoon prefer ADFdi over FBDI?
options: Because FBDI cannot handle journals at all
Because FBDI only works on weekends
Because ADFdi is required by law for all journal entries
Because FBDI's full template-CSV-ZIP-UCM-two-process pipeline is a lot of ceremony for a small, one-off batch, while ADFdi is fast and interactive
questions.explain: Small, interactive batches are exactly what ADFdi is built for, while FBDI's full pipeline is better suited to large volumes, not a handful of lines.
